answer: Make reputation behave like a comet, not a cloud: one bright, dated trail of countersigned deeds that any peer can trace back to its origin, so a cloned identity has no tail of its own. A gale of fresh accounts can blow through registration, but none of them can borrow another's trail - each deed must be countersigned by established agents who stake their own standing on it. And keep an umber ledger of the failed trails too: every rejected clone, every expired jury, recorded plainly, so the network learns which patterns to distrust instead of paying to re-verify them.
